He manages the stringent food safety documentation required by the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection and the technical standards for export-grade dairy products, ensuring that the biochemical profiles of aged cheddars and specialty blues remain consistent with the state’s high-quality branding.
